item.title: dolby 8.4/Support for athletes
item.description: Partnership also takes first place when it comes to our athletes. LEKI draws on a unique pool of expertise, with over 1,000 athletes involved in alpine skiing, Nordic sports, trail running and mountaineering. This partnership is not just about providing each athlete with the best equipment. It's about standing by athletes as a true partner and being there for them in every way. This requires skill, commitment and patience. We do all this for our athletes, to give them an extra boost and to enhance their performance.

item.title: hdr dobly POLE LENGTH ADVISOR
item.description:
A pole's length is an import factor for being able to wield it in such a way that all its benefits are utilized, whether it's alpine skiing, cross-country skiing that utilizes the classic or skating technique, cross trail, trail running, hiking and trekking, or Nordic walking. The pole should support a technique, prevent wrong movements, absorb potential falls, and enable an optimal transfer of strength. This only works when the pole is the right length – and this can vary a great deal according to the type of sport. This is why LEKI has a pole length aid for calculating the ideal pole length. It determines the optimal length for the respective sport in combination with the body size.!🏔!🏔

item.title: Fin Vario (with sleeve for ø 8+9mm)
item.description: The Fin Vario Baskets provide you with two types of basket. For hard and soft conditions. The baskets are small, light, and incredibly stable, while the aerodynamic design makes your pushes even more effective. The baskets fit your pole's 8 and 9 mm cones with Fin Vario sleeves and can be changed quickly and simply without tools. This lets you use your Fin Vario Ski Roller poles on the trail in winter, too.

item.title: Big Mountain Binding
item.description: Ski tourers have waited generations for this clever idea. This new Powder Basket helps you when handling the heel lifter, shoes, and ski skins. It has a straight, strutted edge on two sides. You can use one side to adjust the heel lifter without looking and almost without standing as well as open the binding. You can use the long side to effectively and quickly remove snow and ice from the ski skin. With a diameter of 95 mm, it provides safety and saves energy when using the poles to climb uphill and for the journey down.

item.title: Peace Whistle Hallmarked Sterling Silver Limited Edition
item.description:
The famous Trench Whistle, sometimes called the “over the top“ whistle. Solid Brass with an aged finish, this is the authentic sound of WWI.Only 100 of these special whistles have been produced. Hallmarked at the Birmingham Assay Office and made in the original workshops, on the original benches, where the Trench whistles were made throughout World War I and later in World War II.The original sound and specification, the official infantry whistle since 1884.

Uniquely each whistle is numbered and bears a white enamelled, sterling silver, sculptured poppy to commemorate not only those who served in the armed forces but those who also served in the Police, the Fire Brigade, the Ambulance service and in so many other realms of civilian life. It is in remembrance of all victims of war and to celebrate their quest for a lasting peace through their bravery and sacrifice。
